events.structureRemoved: {name} is pulled from slot {slot}. {bits} bits return to your budget.
events.burstIngestedWithDeletes: The stream surges: {events} events arrive, {deletes} of them retractions.
events.challengeLikeness: The enemy holds up {count} sets of values. Some are close copies of its stream's live values, with a similarity of at least {percent} percent, and some are look-alikes. Choose which to strike.
events.challengePresence: The enemy dangles {count} values before you. Some are really in its stream and some are decoys. Choose which to strike.
events.challengeFrequency: The enemy shields itself behind the value {value}. The shield is as strong as the number of times that value has appeared. Judge that count, then strike with that much force.
events.challengeCount: The enemy shields itself behind the number of distinct values in its stream. Estimate how many there are.
events.challengeRank: The enemy wraps itself in armor at rank {percent} percent: strike with a value that {percent} percent of the values in its stream are at or below. A lower value is blocked, and a much higher one wastes the strike.
events.weakPointRevealed: You have found its weak point: {weakPoint}.
events.strikeFrequencyHit: Your strike lands for {damage} damage. The value had appeared {trueCount} times; you struck with {force}.
events.strikeFrequencyBlocked: Your strike is too weak and the shield turns it aside. You lose {certaintyLost} Certainty. The value had appeared {trueCount} times; you struck with {force}.
events.strikeCountHit: Your estimate is close enough to hurt it: {damage} damage. There were {trueDistinct} distinct values; you said {estimate}.
events.strikeCountMiss: Your estimate is wildly off. You lose {certaintyLost} Certainty. There were {trueDistinct} distinct values; you said {estimate}.
events.strikeRankHit: Your value ranks at {rankPercent} percent, against armor at {percent} percent: {damage} damage. The closer to the armor, the harder it hits.
events.strikeRankBlocked: Your value ranks at only {rankPercent} percent, below the armor at {percent} percent: the strike is turned aside and you lose {certaintyLost} Certainty.
events.strikeLikeness: You strike {realHits} real and {decoyHits} look-alike sets: {damage} damage, {certaintyLost} Certainty lost. {realTotal} of the sets were real.
events.strikePresence: You strike {realHits} real and {decoyHits} decoy targets: {damage} damage, {certaintyLost} Certainty lost. {realTotal} of the targets were real.
events.enemyAttacked: The enemy lashes out. You lose {damage} Certainty.
events.fightWon: The enemy collapses. You win on turn {turn}.
events.fightLostTurnLimit: The stream overflows you. The fight is lost, and the overflow costs {certaintyLost} Certainty.
events.fightLostCertainty: Your Certainty is gone. The run is over.
events.rewardOffered: The fight is won. Choose a reward:
events.restStarted: You reach a rest stop and recover {healed} Certainty.
events.runWon: The act is won in {turns} turns, with {certaintyLeft} Certainty left.
events.enchantedReplacing: {enchantment} is attached to {structure}, and {replaced} returns to the pack.

enemy.second: A second enemy fights beside it, with a stream of its own. What you are asked is about both streams together: put structures on the slots of each enemy, and merge them to answer for both.
enemy.calm: Its stream looks plain and steady.

skew.high: ruled by a handful of favorites

churn.medium: retracts some of what it sends

likeness.low: sends look-alikes that are plainly different
likeness.medium: sends look-alikes that are hard to tell apart
likeness.high: sends look-alikes that are almost the real thing

cunning.medium: sometimes slips in values aimed at your structures
cunning.high: studies your structures and aims values at them

deploy.summary: Place a structure into the next free slot, spending Space. With two enemies, "on 1" or "on 2" picks the enemy it watches.

remove.summary: Remove a structure and get its Space back.

query.summary: Show what your structures say about the current challenge.

strike.usage: strike <numbers> | confirmed | flagged | none | <number> | estimate | high | low
strike.summary: Commit your answer to the challenge.

status.summary: Show your resources, the enemy and your structures.

help.summary: Explain a command or a structure.

choose.summary: Take one of the rewards on offer after a fight.

fuse.summary: At a rest stop, fuse structures you own into a new one. The originals are used up.

leave.summary: Leave the rest stop and go on to the next fight.

enchant.summary: At a rest stop, attach an enchantment to a structure you own. A structure holds one at a time.

game.welcome: Deploy structures, then type "ready" to let the stream arrive. Type "help" for the commands.
game.runWelcome: An act lies ahead: a series of fights, with a reward after each and a rest stop before the Elite. Type "help" for the commands, and "choose <number>" when rewards are offered.
